reference: float64 SciPy sparse Yee difference operators; analytic plane wave and Fresnel coefficient

inputs.all: All input arrays and scalar numerical inputs are saved in each npz; SI units, periodic domain.
inputs.heterogeneous: 21x19, random permittivity 1..5 and three random fields; 45 steps
inputs.wave: 24, 48, 96 square grids over 1 m; diagonal one-cycle plane wave; CFL 0.4; n/2 steps
inputs.reflection: 4x800 grid, 0.005 m spacing, 800 steps, Gaussian width 0.15 m at z=1 m, interface at z=2 m, relative permittivity 1 to 4

tolerances.zero_hz_absolute: 1e-6 V/m for reflection Hz parity and cross-check; exact symmetry gives zero, so relative error is undefined; allows float32 roundoff relative to a unit V/m pulse
tolerances.convergence: error ratio <= 0.30 per refinement, second order
